project_type: Vue 3 + TypeScript SPA with Supabase backend
test_framework: vitest (manual browser testing for visual verification)
test_command: cd frontend && npm run dev, then manual browser testing at http://127.0.0.1:5173
verification_instructions: Run npm run build to ensure no TypeScript errors, then npm run dev and manually inspect the journal editor page at /journal/new and /journal/:id routes. Visual verification is required for this UI-heavy feature. Check browser console for runtime errors.
environment_constraints: Frontend is a standalone Vite app. Backend is Supabase (already deployed with sticker tables). No Laravel server needed for this feature. All changes are frontend-only.
contribution_requirements: Build must complete without TypeScript errors. No new dependencies needed (moveable@0.53.0 already installed). Follow existing Vue 3 Composition API patterns. Match existing color scheme: burgundy #7B0323, cream #F5F1E8, denim #2C4054, tan #d7c7b3.
key_patterns: Components use <script setup lang='ts'> with TypeScript. Props via defineProps<Props>(). Emits via defineEmits<{...}>(). Composables in src/composables/. Services in src/services/. Supabase client in src/lib/supabase.ts. Colors follow vintage journal aesthetic. Form inputs use aria-labels and semantic HTML.
directory_structure: frontend/src/pages/ contains page components, frontend/src/components/journal/ contains journal-specific components including all 5 sticker components, frontend/src/composables/ contains reactive state management, frontend/src/services/ contains Supabase API wrappers, frontend/public/stickers-builtin/ contains 12 SVG built-in stickers
